recommendedBy: session agent, re-triaging after the CI failure of 2026-09-02

items.why: An intermittent stall reds main CI, and nothing yet says whether the guest or its ssh died.
A stale pid file can send SIGKILL to another of your processes after a host reboot.
Creating a sandbox silently changes the permissions of files in the directory you shared.
A store holding real images needs twice its size in host memory to build a microVM disk.
Past fourteen shares a microVM drops one and still reports success.
